explication: Docker Pi-hole packages Pi-hole as a container for network-wide DNS blocking. The main workflow is an operator starting the image, which exposes Pi-hole DNS and web access to the network; optional DHCP and NTP roles are also documented. A baked-in cron job periodically refreshes ad lists and flushes logs. The repository tree shows the container entrypoint and cron configuration, but no source excerpts were provided, so internal call relationships and implementation details are not inferred.
